<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="Vj5_9EE44DSgI_m4n4vF"> <mxGraphModel dx="1720" dy="1133" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 class AuthController {
 +login(AuthRequest) AuthResponse
 }
 class AuthService {
 <<interface>>
 +authenticate(AuthRequest) AuthResponse
 }
 class AuthServiceImpl {
 -AuthenticationManager authenticationManager
 -JwtService jwtService
 +authenticate(AuthRequest) AuthResponse
 }
 class JwtService {
 <<interface>>
 +generateToken(UserDetails) String
 +extractUsername(String) String
 +isTokenValid(String, UserDetails) boolean
 }
 class JwtServiceImpl {
 -SecretKey key
 -long EXPIRATION
 +generateToken(UserDetails) String
 +extractUsername(String) String
 +isTokenValid(String, UserDetails) boolean
 }
 class AppUserDetailsService {
 -UserService userService
 +loadUserByUsername(String) UserDetails
 }
 class JwtRequestFilter {
 -JwtService jwtService
 -UserDetailsService userDetailsService
 -HandlerExceptionResolver handlerExceptionResolver
 #doFilterInternal(request, response, chain)
 }
 class SecurityConfig {
 +securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity) SecurityFilterChain
 +corsFilter() CorsFilter
 +passwordEncoder() PasswordEncoder
 +authenticationManager() AuthenticationManager
 }
 class AuthConstants {
 <<final>>
 +PUBLIC_URL String[]
 }
 class AuthRequest {
 <<DTO>>
 +username String
 +password String
 }
 class AuthResponse {
 <<DTO>>
 +username String
 +role List~String~
 +token String
 }

 AuthController --> AuthService
 AuthService <|.. AuthServiceImpl
 AuthServiceImpl --> JwtService
 JwtService <|.. JwtServiceImpl
 SecurityConfig --> JwtRequestFilter : builds
 SecurityConfig --> AppUserDetailsService
 SecurityConfig --> AuthConstants : permits
 JwtRequestFilter --> JwtService
 JwtRequestFilter --> AppUserDetailsService
 AuthController ..> AuthRequest
 AuthController ..> AuthResponse",
 "config": null
